org2.agenda.command.description: Command used to run org2 (e.g., 'org2' if installed on PATH, or 'node' with org2.agenda.args).

org2.agenda.args.description: Extra args prefixed when calling org2 (advanced; useful for 'node /path/to/dist/cli.js').

org2.agenda.scope.description: Where to read org files from. 'workspace' scans org2.agenda.dir (or the workspace folder if unset); 'files' uses org2.agenda.files.

org2.agenda.dir.description: Root directory to scan when scope='workspace'. If empty, uses the VS Code workspace folder. Useful when your org files live outside the workspace.

org2.agenda.recursive.description: When scope='workspace', recursively scan org2.agenda.dir for .org/.org2 files. If false, scans only the top-level directory.

org2.roam.dailiesDir.description: Root directory for Org2 Roam dailies files (YYYY-MM-DD.org2). If empty, falls back to org2.roam.indexDir, then org2.agenda.dir, then the VS Code workspace folder.

org2.roam.indexDir.description: Root directory for Org2 Roam ID/query/backlinks/db-sync operations. Absolute paths are used directly; relative paths are resolved against org2.agenda.dir (or workspace root). If empty, uses org2.agenda.dir/workspace root.

org2.roam.nodesDir.description: Directory for Org2 Roam node creation (`org2 roam node new`). Absolute paths are used directly; relative paths are resolved against org2.roam.indexDir (or org2.agenda.dir/workspace root). If empty, uses org2.roam.indexDir or org2.agenda.dir/workspace root.

org2.agenda.files.description: List of org/org2 files (absolute or workspace-relative) to include when scope='files'.

org2.agenda.days.description: Default agenda window (in days) for the 'Next N days' filter.

org2.agenda.startDate.description: Optional agenda start date override (YYYY-MM-DD). When set, this replaces the CLI --today anchor for agenda range calculations.

org2.agenda.endDate.description: Optional agenda end date override (YYYY-MM-DD). When set, this replaces the default days-based end date for agenda range calculations.

org2.agenda.limit.description: Maximum number of agenda rows to render after sorting (0 = no limit).

org2.agenda.dayLimit.description: Optional per-date row cap applied after sort/group ordering and before overall `org2.agenda.limit` (0 = no per-date cap).

org2.agenda.includeOverdue.description: Include overdue items in the agenda view.

org2.agenda.statusFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by TODO state bucket before rendering. all=everything, active=todo+in_progress, actionable=active+custom, closed=done+canceled. Alias inputs (for example default/none/backlog/wip/wait/hold/paused/completed/cancelled) normalize automatically; `none` is treated as a no-op sentinel. Comma- or semicolon-separated values are accepted, deduped, and unknown tokens are ignored.

org2.agenda.excludeStatusFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by TODO state bucket before rendering. all=no exclusion, active hides todo+in_progress, closed hides done+canceled. Alias inputs (for example default/none/backlog/wip/wait/hold/paused/completed/cancelled) normalize automatically; `none` is treated as a no-op sentinel. Comma- or semicolon-separated values are accepted, deduped, and unknown tokens are ignored.

org2.agenda.kindFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by planning kind before rendering. all=both SCHEDULED and DEADLINE items.

org2.agenda.excludeKindFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by planning kind before rendering. all=no exclusion, scheduled/deadline hide matching planning rows.

org2.agenda.whenFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by time bucket before rendering. all=overdue+today+upcoming, upcoming=rows after today in the current agenda window.

org2.agenda.excludeWhenFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by time bucket before rendering. all=no exclusion, overdue/today/upcoming hide matching buckets from the current agenda window.

org2.agenda.weekdayFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by weekday tokens before rendering. Supports comma-separated values like `mon,wed`, full names (`monday`), plus `weekday` and `weekend` aliases (use `all` to disable).

org2.agenda.excludeWeekdayFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by weekday tokens before rendering. Supports comma-separated values like `sat,sun`, full names, and `weekday`/`weekend` aliases (use `all` for no exclusion).

org2.agenda.weekFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by ISO week number before rendering. Supports comma-separated values like `1,w2,week10` (use `all` to disable).

org2.agenda.excludeWeekFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by ISO week number before rendering. Supports comma-separated values like `w1,week52` (use `all` for no exclusion).

org2.agenda.dayOfMonthFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by day-of-month numbers before rendering. Supports comma-separated values like `1,15,31` (use `all` to disable).

org2.agenda.excludeDayOfMonthFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by day-of-month numbers before rendering. Supports comma-separated values like `1,31` (use `all` for no exclusion).

org2.agenda.monthFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by month before rendering. Supports comma-separated month numbers (`1..12`) and month name aliases (`jan`, `february`, `mar`) (use `all` to disable).

org2.agenda.excludeMonthFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by month before rendering. Supports comma-separated month numbers (`1..12`) and month name aliases (use `all` for no exclusion).

org2.agenda.quarterFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by calendar quarter before rendering. Supports comma-separated quarter numbers (`1..4`) and aliases like `q1`/`quarter2` (use `all` to disable).

org2.agenda.excludeQuarterFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by calendar quarter before rendering. Supports comma-separated quarter numbers (`1..4`) and aliases like `q3` (use `all` for no exclusion).

org2.agenda.yearFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by year before rendering. Supports comma-separated positive year numbers like `2025,2026` (use `all` to disable).

org2.agenda.excludeYearFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by year before rendering. Supports comma-separated positive year numbers like `2026` (use `all` for no exclusion).

org2.agenda.dateFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by exact dates before rendering. Supports comma-separated `YYYY-MM-DD` values like `2026-03-01,2026-03-15` (use `all` to disable).

org2.agenda.excludeDateFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by exact dates before rendering. Supports comma-separated `YYYY-MM-DD` values like `2026-03-01` (use `all` for no exclusion).

org2.agenda.levelFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by headline level before rendering. Supports comma-separated positive integers like `1,2,3` (empty = no level filter).

org2.agenda.excludeLevelFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by headline level before rendering. Supports comma-separated positive integers like `1,2` (empty = no level exclusion).

org2.agenda.matchFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by headline text (case-insensitive). Supports comma-separated terms; a row matches when any term is present.

org2.agenda.excludeMatchFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by headline text (case-insensitive). Supports comma-separated terms; a row is hidden when any term is present.

org2.agenda.tagFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by headline tags (case-insensitive exact tag match). Supports comma-separated tags; a row matches when any tag is present.

org2.agenda.idFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by headline `:ID:` or `:CUSTOM_ID:` values (case-insensitive exact match). Supports comma-separated IDs; a row matches when any ID/CUSTOM_ID term is present.

org2.agenda.todoKeywordFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by exact TODO keyword (case-insensitive). Supports comma-separated keywords; a row matches when any keyword is present.

org2.agenda.todoOrder.description: Optional custom ordering for TODO keywords used by `agenda --sort todo` / `--group todo` (comma-separated, for example `TODO,IN_PROGRESS,BLOCKED,DONE`; blank keeps default alphabetical ordering).

org2.agenda.statusOrder.description: Optional custom ordering for normalized status buckets used by `agenda --sort status` / `--group status` (comma- or semicolon-separated values from `todo`, `in_progress`, `done`, `canceled`, `custom`; aliases like `default`, `none`, `all`, `active`, `actionable`, `open`, `prog`, `wait`, `hold`, `paused`, `completed`, and `closed` are accepted and normalized before CLI args are built).

org2.agenda.kindOrder.description: Optional custom ordering for planning kinds used by `agenda --sort kind` / `--group kind` (comma-separated values from `scheduled`, `deadline`; blank keeps default lexical ordering).

org2.agenda.priorityOrder.description: Optional custom ordering for priority markers used by `agenda --sort priority` / `--group priority` (comma-separated values from `A..Z` or `0..9`, accepts bracketed forms like `[#A]`; blank keeps default A→Z then 0→9 ordering).

org2.agenda.tagOrder.description: Optional custom ordering for tags used by `agenda --sort tags` / `--group tags` (comma-separated tag names, case-insensitive; rows with listed tags are ranked first in the provided order, and unlisted tags keep lexical fallback ordering).

org2.agenda.effortOrder.description: Optional custom ordering for effort values used by `agenda --sort effort` / `--group effort` (comma-separated effort tokens like `0:30,45m,2h`; aliases `none`, `empty`, `unset`, and `no-effort` target rows without `:EFFORT:`).

org2.agenda.priorityFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by Org priority marker (for example `A,B` or `[#A],[#B]`, case-insensitive).

org2.agenda.timeFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by planning clock-time tokens. Supports comma-separated terms, exact `HH:MM` matches, inclusive ranges like `09:00-12:30` (including overnight windows), and aliases like `timed`/`untimed`.

org2.agenda.effortFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by `:EFFORT:` property value (case-insensitive exact match; supports comma-separated OR terms like `0:30,30m,1h`).

org2.agenda.propertyFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by exact headline drawer property terms using `KEY=VALUE` (case-insensitive; supports comma-separated OR terms).

org2.agenda.excludeTagFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by headline tags (case-insensitive exact tag match). Supports comma-separated tags; a row is hidden when any tag matches.

org2.agenda.excludeIdFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by headline `:ID:` or `:CUSTOM_ID:` values (case-insensitive exact match). Supports comma-separated IDs; a row is hidden when any ID/CUSTOM_ID term matches.

org2.agenda.excludeTodoKeywordFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by exact TODO keyword (case-insensitive). Supports comma-separated keywords; a row is hidden when any keyword matches.

org2.agenda.excludePriorityFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by Org priority marker (for example `A,B` or `[#A],[#B]`, case-insensitive).

org2.agenda.excludeTimeFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by planning clock-time tokens. Supports comma-separated terms, exact `HH:MM` matches, inclusive ranges like `09:00-12:30` (including overnight windows), and aliases like `timed`/`untimed`.

org2.agenda.excludeEffortFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by `:EFFORT:` property value (case-insensitive exact match; supports comma-separated OR terms like `0:30,30m,1h`).

org2.agenda.excludePropertyFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by exact headline drawer property terms using `KEY=VALUE` (case-insensitive; supports comma-separated OR terms).

org2.agenda.fileFilter.description: Filter agenda rows by source file path (case-insensitive substring match). Supports comma-separated terms; a row matches when its file path contains any term.

org2.agenda.excludeFileFilter.description: Exclude agenda rows by source file path (case-insensitive substring match). Supports comma-separated terms; a row is hidden when its file path contains any term.

org2.agenda.sortBy.description: Sort agenda rows within each date by one or more keys (`file`, `headline`, `todo`, `status`, `priority`, `effort`, `id`, `level`, `time`, `kind`, `tags`, `line`). Supports comma-separated values; prefix a key with `-` (or suffix with `:desc`) for descending order. Use `default` for existing ordering.

org2.agenda.groupBy.description: Group agenda rows within each date by one or more keys (`file`, `headline`, `todo`, `status`, `priority`, `effort`, `id`, `level`, `time`, `kind`, `tags`, `line`). Supports comma-separated values; prefix a key with `-` (or suffix with `:desc`) for reverse group ordering. Use `default` to disable grouping.

org2.agenda.groupLimit.description: Optional per-date per-group row cap when `org2.agenda.groupBy` is set (0 = no per-group cap).

org2.agenda.dateOrder.description: Overall date ordering for agenda groups. Use `asc` for oldest-first or `desc` for newest-first.

org2.formatter.fileFilter.description: Limit workspace formatter check/apply commands to files whose paths contain any comma-separated term (case-insensitive substring match).

org2.formatter.excludeFileFilter.description: Exclude files from workspace formatter check/apply commands when paths contain any comma-separated term (case-insensitive substring match).

org2.formatter.configFile.description: Optional org2.json path for workspace formatter commands. When set, workspace check/apply uses `org2 fmt --config <path>` instead of scanning `org2.agenda.dir` recursively.

org2.capture.defaultFile.description: Optional default target file for `Org2: Capture Quick Entry`. Absolute paths are used directly; relative paths are resolved against org2.agenda.dir (or workspace root).

org2.capture.defaultTemplate.description: Default template ordering for `Org2: Capture Quick Entry` (`note` or `task`).

org2.capture.defaultTodoKeyword.description: Default TODO keyword ordering for task captures in `Org2: Capture Quick Entry` (`TODO`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `DONE`, `CANCELED`, or `CANCELLED`).

org2.capture.useSelectionAsBody.description: When enabled, `Org2: Capture Quick Entry` passes the current editor selection as capture body text (`--body`).

org2.export.outputDir.description: Output directory for `Org2: Export Workspace Org Files to HTML`. Absolute paths are used directly; relative paths are resolved against org2.agenda.dir (or workspace root).

org2.export.indexFile.description: Optional index file path for workspace HTML export (`--index`). Empty disables index generation. Relative paths are resolved inside org2.export.outputDir.

org2.export.indexTitle.description: Title used for the generated workspace export index page (`--index-title`). Ignored when org2.export.indexFile is empty.

org2.export.stylesheets.description: Optional comma/newline-separated stylesheet URLs or paths passed as repeated `--css` flags to HTML export commands.

org2.export.includeDefaultStyle.description: When enabled, HTML export includes Org2's built-in inline stylesheet. Disable to use external CSS only (`--no-default-style`).

org2.export.includeToc.description: When enabled, HTML export includes a generated table of contents with heading anchors (`--toc`).

org2.export.tocDepth.description: Optional TOC heading depth limit for HTML export. Values >0 pass `--toc-depth N` (and implicitly enable TOC); 0 keeps full-depth TOC behavior.

org2.export.numberHeadings.description: When enabled, HTML export prefixes headings (and TOC entries when present) with generated section numbers (`--number-headings`).

org2.export.numberHeadingsDepth.description: Optional heading-number depth limit for HTML export. Values >0 pass `--number-headings-depth N` (and implicitly enable heading numbers); 0 keeps full-depth numbering behavior.

org2.export.rewriteFileLinks.description: When enabled, HTML export rewrites Org file links to `.html` targets for published output and emits heading anchor IDs (including `:CUSTOM_ID:` targets) for rewritten `::* Heading` / `::#custom-id` links (`--rewrite-file-links`).

org2.formatOnSave.description: Auto-format Org tables on save (runs `org2 fmt --stdin` and replaces the document).

org2.todo.writeTransitionLogbook.description: When enabled, TODO status updates from VS Code pass `--logbook` to org2 so state transitions are recorded in a LOGBOOK drawer.

org2.editor.restoreSelectionAfterCliAppl.description: Restore the previous selection after TODO/planning/archive commands apply and refresh the file from disk. Disable this if your setup still auto-expands folds around the cursor.

org2.editor.refreshAfterCliApply.description: Force a post-apply disk refresh (`revertResource`) after TODO/planning/archive commands. TODO/planning only refresh when CLI output reports an actual change. Disable to rely on VS Code file watching and avoid refresh-related fold churn entirely.

org2.editor.skipRefreshWhenInSync.description: When refresh-after-apply is enabled, skip explicit refresh if the open editor already matches on-disk content after CLI apply (reduces unnecessary fold churn).

org2.editor.allowGlobalRefreshFallback.description: Allow fallback to global `workbench.action.files.revert` when target-file `revertResource` is unavailable. Keep disabled to avoid global refresh side-effects (including fold churn in other editors).

org2.editor.navigationReveal.description: Reveal behavior after Org2 non-agenda navigation commands (backlinks/open-file/open-id): outside is default and only recenters when target is offscreen, default uses normal VS Code reveal, center always recenters, none avoids forced reveal to reduce fold auto-expansion.

org2.editor.navigationRevealFromAgenda.description: Reveal behavior specifically when opening items from the agenda. Default none avoids forced reveal calls (helps preserve folded context); default inherits org2.editor.navigationReveal, while outside/center force agenda-specific recentering.

org2.folding.autoFoldMaxHeadingLevel.description: Auto-fold headings at this exact level (1 = fold top-level sections, 2 = fold level-2 sections, 0 = disable auto-folding headings).

org2.folding.autoFoldPropertyDrawers.description: Auto-fold :PROPERTIES: drawers when a document is opened (once per file).

org2.links.renderDescriptions.description: Style described links ([[url][desc]]) for readability without changing layout/whitespace.

org2.links.renderDescriptionsMode.description: Reserved for future link-rendering modes. Currently both modes use layout-safe styling only.

org2.keymap.power.description: Enable Org2 power keymap chords (macOS: cmd+; then key, Linux/Windows: ctrl+; then key) for Org/Org2 editors.

org2.vim.visibleLineNavigation.description: When VSCodeVim is active in Normal mode, remap j/k in Org/Org2 editors to VS Code cursorDown/cursorUp so folded sections navigate by visible lines.

org2.crypt.recipients.description: Default GPG recipients for Org2 crypt encrypt/reencrypt commands. Use this for your own device/user key plus agent keys.

org2.crypt.recipientFiles.description: Default GPG recipient files passed to org2 crypt encrypt/reencrypt.

org2.crypt.encryptOnSave.description: Automatically encrypt plaintext :crypt: subtrees before saving Org/Org2 files. Save is canceled if encryption fails.

org2.crypt.passphrase.description: Optional symmetric passphrase for automatic :crypt: encryption on save. Prefer org2.crypt.recipients or org2.crypt.recipientFiles for public-key encryption.

org2.crypt.gpgProgram.description: GPG executable used for automatic :crypt: encryption on save.
